messages:
Rhea (Product): Dropping new playground iteration into the channel. Focus areas: streaming UX, concise token counter, and making prompt-library insert less surprising. Figma: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/playground-iter-5. Quick runthrough?

Lucas (Design): Love the condensed counter. Two tiny asks: 1) rename 'Stop' to 'Pause' and show a subtle 'Stop & keep' under an overflow menu; 2) token counter should show an animated microchange when tokens increase so users notice without being distracted. Also propose a small preview flyout for prompt-library items that shows +N tokens on hover.

Priya (Eng): Implementation note: Can't do server resume easily. Suggest client pause by aborting the stream and retaining the text; on resume send the buffered text as a prefix. Need to handle deduping and truncated token boundaries. We'll include a `resumed_session` metric and a `partial_token_count` field.

Marco (A11y): Screen reader flakiness: continuous streaming triggers verbosity. Avoid aria-live across all updates. Use a single summary live region that updates every 250-500ms. Ensure Pause/Stop are focusable and have aria-pressed state if toggled. Token counter needs role=progressbar and aria-valuetext like "Tokens: 120 of 2048". Contrast for the token pill is low on the light theme. Use a darker foreground or stroke to meet 4.5:1.

Ivy (DevEx): Microcopy: tooltip = "Tokens · used 120 / cap 2048 · est cost $0.02". For prompt-library show a confirmation: "Insert will add +15 tokens (est $0.003). Insert?" Events: add `prompt_insert_token_delta` and `generation_pause_type` to analytics.

Lucas (Design): Variant uploaded where Pause sits as a small neutral button next to the timestamp, with accessible hit target >= 44px. Also added subtle shimmer during streaming to indicate progress. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/playground-iter-5b

Rhea (Product): Decisions: primary label = 'Pause', secondary = 'Stop & keep' in overflow. Token tooltip per Ivy. Accessibility batching per Marco.

Priya (Eng): I'll prototype client-side pause POC. We'll implement overlap dedup using suffix-prefix comparison of last 64 characters and a naive hash. Expect POC in ~4 days.

Marco (A11y): I'll add acceptance tests for screen readers and keyboard nav. Recommend batching interval default 300ms and make it configurable for testing.

Ivy (DevEx): I'll add tooltip copy and analytics keys to the devex branch. Also will create a UI experiment to measure if Pause increases regenerate rate.

Rhea (Product): Action items: Lucas -> finalize visuals; Priya -> POC + dedup heuristics; Marco -> A11y tests; Ivy -> analytics + tooltip. Scheduling short sync Friday. Thanks! :sparkles:
